project.name: Jikan
project.audience: developers building apps and tools that consume MyAnimeList data
project.framework: PHP ^8.4, Composer PSR-4 library; Symfony BrowserKit/CssSelector/HttpClient for scraping myanimelist.net; PHPUnit + paratest. Deliberate non-features (do not report as gaps): no HTTP server or routes, no authentication, no stateful API service, no request-facing controller layer. This is a client library: Jikan\\Http\\HttpClientWrapper is the single outbound network edge and every public call is a read against an external site.
